title: Great!
text: Great!. My husband likes all of our storage tubs to be the same brand and size so they stack easily. These are different. But I knew that when I ordered them. There are 6 of these tubs. I ordered them specifically for our son. He's graduating from college soon. He has no immediate plans to move out of the house yet, but he's beginning to go through his stuff. These tubs will go with him. They are a good size for storage, yet not too large that they'll become too heavy when they're full. They are very sturdy and durable. Some plastic tubs feel cheap, these do not. They would make an excellent choice for your storage needs.

product_metadata.title: Rubbermaid ECOSense Storage Containers with Lids, 54 Gal Pack of 2, Durable and Reusable Stackable Storage Bins for Garage or Home Organization, Made From Recycled Materials
features: Sustainable Solution – With proven Rubbermaid durability, live more environmentally-friendly with ECOSense Storage Totes made from recycled materials. They are 100% recyclable making it a fully sustainable, closed loop recycling initiative.

Quality Design - Durable ECOSense Storage Containers are equipped with a snap tight lid that protects contents from moisture and pests, making them the perfect garage storage bins. These totes for storage are durable and built for long term use.

Stackable Storage – Made with recessed lids, these plastic totes serve as stacking bins that don't crack or buckle under pressure. Built-in handles also make it easy to carry the heavy duty storage bins or stack them for organization and storage.

Heavy Duty Build – Ideal for large or bulky items, dog food storage, heavy tools, sporting equipment, camping supplies, blanket storage, clothing storage and more. Trust these plastic storage bins with lids to protect your items and maximize space.

Maximize Your Space – With 54 gallons of storage volume, these totes are the ideal large storage containers for use as closet organization, bedroom storage, attic tidying, garage organization and storage, basement storage, and much more.
description: Trust the ECOSense Storage Bin with Lid to keep your items secure. This sturdy storage basket with lid can withstand harsh temperatures, keeping your belongings protected in all environments. Perfect for chilly garages and sweltering attics where off-season items are commonly stored. The plastic containers with lids are excellent as clothes storage, blanket bins, pet food storage containers, toy storage totes, craft storage boxes, and other organizational needs. These storage tubs are made from recycled materials and are 100% recyclable making it a fully sustainable, closed loop recycling initiative. Made in the USA. Dimensions: 42.5” L x 21.375” W x 18.25” H.
